Question: Do Indian actors refuse to work with Pakistani actresses? If so, why?
Old_Answer: They generally didn’t used to, especially prior to 2016. Many actors have appeared opposite Pakistani actresses. This list includes pairs such as Shah Rukh Khan & Mahira Khan, Mithun Chakraborty & Salma Agha , Saif Ali Khan & Somy Ali, Ashmit Patel & Meera, Himesh Reshammiya & Sara Loren, Harshwardhan Rane & Mawra Hocane, and Irrfan Khan & Saba Qamar, etc etc etc. But then the Uri terror attack happened in 2016, and Pakistani actors were banned in Bollywood movies. Then the 2019 Pulwama terror attack happened, and the All Indian Cine Workers Association announced a total ban on all Pakistani actors and artists. As of today, the ban is still in effect - so, even if Indian actors would want to work with Pakistani actresses, they would probably not be able to do so, unless the ban is lifted. And, till the ban is lifted, Indian movie producers aren’t going to be very keen on casting Pakistani actresses in their films.
